sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 640x512, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <= 35 mK; optical: 1/1.8in CMOS
features: Optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 40x optical zoom (6 to 240 mm)
Temperature measurement -20 to 550 C, accuracy max. (+/-2 C / 2%)
Dynamic fire and smoke detection (up to 10 fire points and 10 smoke points)
Perimeter protection VCA: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance and exit
Picture-in-picture thermal/optical fusion display, target coloration
Explosion-proof 316L stainless steel housing (ATEX / IECEx), IP68, IK10
Optical IR illuminator up to 200 m, wiper
Uncooled VOx thermal detector, 17 um pixel pitch, NETD <= 35 mK
release_notes: Hikvision explosion-proof thermographic bi-spectrum network positioning system (PTZ) with a 640x512 VOx thermal module (25 mm lens) and a 4 MP 40x optical camera for perimeter protection and fire prevention in hazardous areas. 316L stainless-steel ATEX/IECEx housing, temperature measurement -20 to 550 C.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical is Channel 1, thermal is Channel 2.
